title: Big Eye Louis Nelson ranked among clarinetists
summary: Bocage calls Big Eye very talented, able to play anything after hearing it once and gifted with chords.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Clarinetist, how did Big Eye rank with the others?

Well, yeah, well, for talent, he's very talented, you know what I mean? He's one of them fellas that could play most anything if he heard it once he could play, you know what I'm saying? And he knew chords, he was very gifted for that, and that made him good, you see.
